Lunar Caustic
Like Water and Lithium
The Shadows Lengthen in...
Blithe Hospitality
Sal Volatile
Tara went inside the forge, and started skimming a book left behind on that table. Could you ask her to read it to me? I don't remember if I'm literate, but I liked all the stories she told me about your adventures. Did you know she wrote them down?
+ When Completed
- When Completed
The names here, Brentan and Sigrid. I didn't see them in Thelima. It looks like you and Tara care a lot about Brentan in particular. Why don't you take the guestbook with you? That's too selfish? Really? I want to think about that more.
Items Required:
Talk to Tara x1
Talk to
Tara
Read Guestbook x1
Click and read through the Guestbook on Screen 5

0 Gold
5,000 Exp
125 Rep :
Yew Mountains
Requirements:

Dahlia shot off as soon as the forge's doors opened. Tara's pointing down the western hall. It smells smokey, which means there are Maleno Elementals around. We should clear that side, and see what Dahlia's doing. The Elementals aren't bothering her. If she's not human, is she one of them?
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Looks like Tara's right. Dahlia isn't up to anything that'll get in our way, so I'll drop this brick. My gut instinct always tells me to attack, or else. The Planar Conflict sounded crazy. Maybe if I wasn't always ready to fight, there'd be no saving anyone.
Items Required:
Talk to Dahlia x1

Dahlia

I ticked Warlic off pretty bad. He went down the eastern hall to deal with the Draconians that broke into the forge. They came to help that Dragon claim it as their lair. Think Warlic would be less angry if we talked and got rid of the Draconians together?
+ When Completed
- When Completed
I overheard your conversation. If you and Tara need to talk about something with Warlic, then Volgritian and I can go chase squirrels. We just need to seal the forge first, or that thing that attacked Thelima's going to catch up. Hm…I guess not knowing what Warlic wants does make me…sad?

Warlic

The guardian of Maleno, Admin B, said the room containing the flames is locked. That's…weird. The key should be in one of the other rooms, so try pushing yourself up against their doors. While you're doing that…
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Hey, lean in. While you were looking for the key, I checked the forge's main doors. They opened a little. We didn't need the key to unlock them at all. Why did Admin B make you look for it? They're not even asking for it back.
Items Required:
Carcossa Card Key x1
Go to the mark on Screen 9
Rewards:
0 Gold
5,000 Exp
125 Rep :
Yew Mountains
Requirements:
Must have completed the previous quest.
I told Tara about the key. She thinks it's a trap. Like, a surprise that's going to hurt us. Wait, of course you'd already know what that is. I'm going to help her prepare in case it is a trap while you clear out the last of the Elementals and Draconians.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Bad news, Admin B interrupted Tara and I to show us a funny movie. It was a moving picture of us whispering about cutting some wires. They asked if we'd like to get a close and personal tour of their motherboard. We said no…

There's nothing we can do but destroy the Dragon, inside Maleno's flames, and hope that Admin B is going to seal the forge. They told us the Fire Dragon's name was Idalion the Elegant. Remember? Tara doesn't like hurting Dragons so it's up to us.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Nothing good comes out of fighting fire with fire. Got it.

Volgritian and I need to get scanned, which is taking a while. Should it be this long? We can't seal Maleno's flame until it's done, so why not take this chance and use it? Alchemic materials from the Elementals and Dragons should be enough to get something started.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
The scan's making me feel weird. Not sick in body, but in…my heart? I don't know. Tara says it's weird that the Guardian's practically staring into my pores. But, you got the supply started! Lead's okay to touch without gloves, right?

Jaania disappeared, and all of the Turrets and Droids went crazy again! We can't get through to the forge if - Who's Jaania? You still don't remember her being here? Don't worry, I'll tell you everything after we trash these gizmos!
+ When Completed
- When Completed
So, there was this blue lady that was with us in the forge the entire time! You kept whispering to me about how cryptic and wink-wink-nudge she was being, like you were supposed to understand what she was saying. Uh, Warlic's glaring at me. We'll come back to this later.

The thing that chased you on Mount Maleno's lurking in the center of Forge Albedo. I promise I won't take the flames until Warlic says it's okay, so let's take your stalker down. And then do it a third time if we need to, 'cause that's supposed to be the charm. Right?
+ When Completed
- When Completed

I shouldn't stay in the Sanctuary. It's safer for me to be here, where I can't hurt anyone by accident. You want to stay with me? R-really? It's dangerous with all the Turrets, Doids, and the Flames of Albedo's remnants. We'd need to get rid of them first.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
I don't know what to say or do to make things better. We need to rescue everyone that was kidnapped by the Lightguard, but…I made your burns worse. Oh no, Tara! Is she alright? Did I hurt her, too?

The journey it took to get here, and the adventure you, Tara, Warlic, and I shared… Let's retrace our steps, and collet the embers Kolr stole from every mountain. Inherit the Flame of Maleno, Albedo, Citrinitas, and Rubedo to walk towards a new dawn.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
I used to exist because of the hatred and bloodlust my father put into my heart. That died, taking me with it, and someone new emerged from the ashes. My flames are yours now, as is my life. You're more than a Scion of Flames. You're family to me.

The original Kolr's soul has been completely incinerated by the flames he stole from me, but his lingering will and hate remains. Lay what's left of him to rest, and you'll inherit my divine flames.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
If I had tried to lend you my flames directly, there's a chance you'd turn to ashes on the spot. Slowly exposing yourself to them through the Magnum Opus forges and fighting Kolr helped you acclimate. In a way, Kolr played his part in protecting Lore.

Self-Infested
Requirements:
Must have completed the '
Clematis' Aspirations
' quest.
The power went out, and only Ouroboros can see through the darkness. We're going to have to feel our way around, or follow the light from the Citrinitas Elementals down the west hall. Ask Ouroboros if he can guide us, and catch some of those Elementals.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Ouroboros said he can sense his brethren moving through the cabins… and something else. I can see them too. Blue lights, vaguely shaped like people pacing back and forth. Are they ghosts?
Items Required:
Elemental Flame x8
Dropped by
Citrinitas Elemental (Monster) (Version 3)
Talk to Ouroboros x1
Talk to
Ouroboros
Rewards:
18,000 Gold
81,000 Exp
Requirements:
Must have completed the previous quest.
I checked the room on the far left. It's full of beds, and Astero's cronies are making a mess of it. There are other people in there, but the Matches' attack phase right through them. Let's see if we can get their attention after we put out the flames.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
The red figures are Doom Spirits, like Dahlia and Ouroboros, who seem to be trapped here. They're friends with blue shapes, but those don't seem to be, uh, self-aware? Ouroboros said they're like visible memories, left behind to torture the surviving crew.
Items Required:
Match's Hauberk x6
Dropped by:
Citrinitas Match (1) (Version 3)
Citrinitas Match (2) (Version 3)

Talk to
Carcossa Pilot
Talk to Ethereal Shadow x1
Talk to
Carcossa Shadow
Rewards:
18,000 Gold
81,000 Exp
Requirements:
Must have completed the previous quest.
I lost track of Sigrid. She must have gone ahead of us. We should find her, and look for any other Shadows or Afterimages. They can't exactly answer questions, or even talk to us, but maybe they'll repeat something that'll lead us to Zigfried and Cassilda.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Captain Zigfried sounded a bit crazy, but I can see why his crew were willing to follow him to the ends of the universe. If someone made me feel the same way that Afterimage did… Is this why people keep doing horrible things to each other?
Items Required:
Talk to Sigrid x1
Talk to
Sigrid Sunshield (NPC)
Listen to Blue Afterimage x1
Talk to
Carcossa Pilot
Rewards:
0 Gold
5,000 Exp
Requirements:
Must have completed the previous quest.
Look through the window behind Sigrid. I think that's the Cryostasis Chamber. She said a lot of the doors are blocked, but the one next to her just needs a card key. You think any of the Elementals or Matches picked it up? No harm in checking.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
The door opened, and it blasted me with a flood of stale air. It's a good thing I shielded you. There's already a tickle in the back of my throat. Could be a bug, or a parasite. Back when I was, uh, big and mean, huge parasites used to try sneaking into my head.
Items Required:
Cryostasis Card Key x1
Dropped by:
Citrinitas Elemental (Monster) (Version 3)
Citrinitas Match (1) (Version 3)
Citrinitas Match (2) (Version 3)
Rewards:
18,000 Gold
81,000 Exp
Requirements:
Must have completed the previous quest.
The Cryostasis Chamber's open now. It's completely silent. That recording of Captain Zigfried and Dr. Cassilda told us to come here, but I don't see them around. Should we look inside the pods?
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Ouroboros says he hears murmuring… Oh! I see something moving inside the middle pod!
Items Required:
Access Cryostasis Chamber x1
Enter Screen 5
Inspect Cryostasis Pods x3
Click on the blue arrows around the map
Rewards:
0 Gold
5,000 Exp
Requirements:
Must have completed the previous quest.
Zigfried gave us a solution! We just need to find a way to get deeper into Carcossa to wake all of his Doom Spirits up. Sigrid said the east hall is more dangerous, but all the other doors are blocked. It's fine We'll handle any monsters we run into.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Weren't those Luma Lifeforms? They're evolving. Now we know that the Lifeforms are actually Doom Spirits Dr. Cassilda experimented on. They wanted to become human, but unlike the red shades, they were reborn as a thing between life and death…
Items Required:
Lifeform's Cyst x12
Dropped by
Evolved Lifeform
Rewards:
18,000 Gold
81,000 Exp
Requirements:
Must have completed the previous quest.
Down the east hall, the door on the left leads to another room full of beds. I'll look around for doors or hatches. You try to listen in on those Red Shades and Blue Afterimages. Maybe they'll talk about an emergency escape shaft.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
I couldn't find a way down. What about you? …The crew of the Carcossa were close to each other, but there were still people like that Red Shadow. Even if we need them to defeat The Law, they'll be the threats of tomorrow…
Items Required:
Listen to the Pair x1
Talk to
Carcossa Pilot
Listen to Red Shadow x1
Talk to
Carcossa Shadow
Rewards:
0 Gold
5,000 Exp
Requirements:
Must have completed the previous quest.
The smell from the next room burns my nose. Is this where Dr. Cassilda experimented on the Carcossa's crew? I hear creatures skittering across the ground. There might be a way down inside, but we need to stomp those bugs first.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
I tried asking Ouroboros if those leeches were Doom Spirits, but he bit me for insulting him. If they aren't Doom Spirits, what are they? Hm? You think they could be normal leeches that mutated when they drank out of the Cryostasis Pods? Ah…
Items Required:
Leech's Stomach Pouch x15
Dropped by
Doom Leech (Level 67)
Rewards:
18,000 Gold
81,000 Exp
Requirements:
Must have completed the previous quest.
Ouro was bonking his nose against one of the monitors, and brought up a map. There's an emergency escape shaft that leads deeper into Carcossa. We're close! Once we clear out the Lifeforms and Leeches, we'll cross the threshold.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Normal leeches are a lot smaller, aren't they? What do you think happens if something else drinks out of the Cryostasis pods? Hey, Ouro just flinched so hard, his entire body curled into a tangled ball. You think he's okay?
Items Required:
Lifeform's Cranium x9
Dropped by
Evolved Lifeform
Leech's Sucker x9
Dropped by
Doom Leech
Rewards:
18,000 Gold
81,000 Exp
Requirements:
Must have completed the previous quest.
Do you hear it? The roaring… Clementis' sister must be coming to rescue her. We can't let Astero know that we're here, or what we're after. You, me, Sigrid, and Ouro against one Dragon! Easy! But why is my stomach aching all of a sudden?
+ When Completed
- When Completed
What happened to Clementine? And… What's that in her mouth?
Items Required:
Clementine Defeated x1
Dropped by
Clementine
Rewards:
36,000 Gold
162,000 Exp
